card.name: Waiting for a body's decision or vote
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words right before a committee, court, board or agency is about to decide, rule or vote, such as 'expected to', 'will' or 'are taken by'.

modes.label: Expected decision
modes.description: Words like 'to' or 'make' after a body is expected to decide on something.
modes.example: The World Heritage Committee is expected<< to>> make a decision on the nomination at its

modes.label: Court or board action
modes.description: Verbs or body names just before a court, board or legislature acts, delays or votes.
modes.example: at year's end they<< awaited>> Supreme Court action.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words about voting and deciding, such as 'vote', 'votes' and 'decision'.
card.plain: It lights up when a text is about to say that an official body will decide or vote.
